head: Vorm
Gebruik
Voorbeeld
rows: will
voorspelling, besluit nu, belofte
I think it'll rain. I'll help you.
going to
plan, voorspelling op basis van nu
I'm going to move. Look, it's going to fall!
present continuous
vaste afspraak
I'm meeting the boss at ten.
present simple
dienstregeling, programma
The plane lands at 6.15.
will be + -ing
bezig op een moment in de toekomst
This time tomorrow I'll be lying on the beach.
will have + deelwoord
klaar vóór een moment in de toekomst
By Friday I'll have finished the report.

blocks.label: regelmatig werkwoord
examples: Om zes uur ben ik klaar.
Will you have finished by Monday?
She'll have finished her degree by June.
In juni heeft zij haar studie afgerond.
We'll have finished the house by spring.
In het voorjaar is het huis klaar.
You'll have finished the course by then.
Tegen die tijd hebben jullie de cursus afgerond.
They won't have finished before Christmas.
Ze zijn niet voor Kerstmis klaar.

blocks.text: Future continuous: Don't call at eight; I'll be having dinner. (Bel niet om acht uur; dan zit ik te eten.) Ook als beleefde vraag naar plannen: Will you be using the car tonight? (Heb je de auto vanavond nodig?)

blocks.title: by = uiterlijk, tegen
blocks.text: Bij de future perfect hoort vaak by: by Friday = uiterlijk vrijdag, by the time you arrive = tegen de tijd dat je aankomt. Het Nederlands gebruikt hier vaak de tegenwoordige tijd: Vrijdag ben ik klaar = I'll have finished by Friday.

head: Vorm
Voorbeeld
Nederlands
rows: be about to
Hurry up, the train is about to leave.
De trein staat op het punt te vertrekken.
be due to
The meeting is due to start at nine.
De vergadering begint volgens plan om negen uur.
be likely to
Prices are likely to rise.
De prijzen zullen waarschijnlijk stijgen.
be bound to
You're bound to pass. You've worked so hard.
Je slaagt zeker.
be on the point of
She was on the point of leaving.
Ze stond op het punt te vertrekken.

blocks.text: Vanuit het verleden naar de toekomst kijken doe je met was going to en would: I was going to call you, but I forgot. (Ik was van plan je te bellen.) She knew she would miss him.

rows: At ten tomorrow I will lie on the beach.
At ten tomorrow I will be lying on the beach.
Bezig op een moment: will be + -ing.
I will finish it until Friday.
I will have finished it by Friday.
Uiterlijk: by, met de future perfect.
The train is about leaving.
The train is about to leave.
be about to + werkwoord.
When I will arrive, I'll call you.
When I arrive, I'll call you.
Na when: present simple.
I wanted to call you, but I forgot it.
I was going to call you, but I forgot.
Een plan in het verleden: was going to.
Prices are likely rise.
Prices are likely to rise.
be likely to + werkwoord.

blocks.text: Vul de juiste toekomstvorm in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: This time next week I ______ in Spain.
items.full: This time next week I will be skiing in Spain.
By 2030 they will have built the new bridge.

items.q: Quick, the film is ______ to start!
items.full: Quick, the film is about to start!

items.q: The plane is ______ to land at six.
items.full: The plane is due to land at six.

items.q: I'll have finished the report ______ Monday.
items.full: I'll have finished the report by Monday.

items.q: Don't phone at seven. I ______ dinner.
items.full: Don't phone at seven. I will be having dinner.

items.q: I ______ going to visit you, but my car broke down.
items.full: I was going to visit you, but my car broke down.

items.q: She's very talented. She's ______ to win.
items.full: She's very talented. She's bound to win.

items.q: By the time you get home, I ______ to bed.
items.full: By the time you get home, I will have gone to bed.

items.q: ______ you be using the car this evening?
items.full: Will you be using the car this evening?

items.q: Vrijdag ben ik klaar met het rapport.
items.a: I'll have finished the report by Friday.

items.q: Morgen om deze tijd lig ik op het strand.
items.a: This time tomorrow I'll be lying on the beach.

items.q: De trein staat op het punt te vertrekken.
items.a: The train is about to leave.

items.q: Ik was van plan je te bellen.
items.a: I was going to call you.
